contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Denarius of Septimius Severus dating from AD 193-194 (Reece Period 10). Eastern mint. Obv: IMP CE L SEP SE-(V PERT ...), laureate head right. Rev: [BONAE] S-P-EI II COS, Spes walking left, lifting the hem of her skirt and holding a flower in right hand. Ref: Cf. RIC IV, pt 1, p. 140, nos. 364-366 var. Note: The obverse legend should read: "IMP CAE L SEP SEV[...]", but instead reads "IMP CE L SEP…
